timeline.text: Every insulin dose Artem's parents worked out lived only in their heads, or on a scrap of paper.
No record for the doctor. No history of how his settings changed over time.
Estimating carbs for a new meal meant guessing from a label in a language nobody could read fast enough.
Now every dose and setting change gets logged automatically, with a timestamp.
A photo of the meal, read by AI vision, fills in the carbs — one photo instead of a label lookup.
